title: Published chat package imported an absent data subpath and blocked extension CI
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; package CI is independent of sign-in
preconditions: Use extension CI run 38257589484 with published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
The run reached unit tests against the current published package graph.
reproduction: Run extension CI run 38257589484 with @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23 in the dependency graph.
Observe four unit-test suites fail with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.
Trace the package error to published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62/dist/host/diagnostics.js importing @ai-matrx/data/net, a subpath not exported by @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
expected: The latest published shared-package graph exports every subpath imported by its dependents, so extension unit tests and mandatory CI pass. A stale or incompatible package graph is identified before it reaches release acceptance.
actual: Extension CI run 38257589484 failed four unit-test suites with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED because published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 imported @ai-matrx/data/net, absent from @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23 exports. Corrected shared chat source was published as @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.63 after the chat job in aidream run 38252153771 succeeded; its public tarball diagnostics imports @ai-matrx/api/net and a scan of 1,553 dist JavaScript files found zero data/net imports. The extension package graph is refreshed to chat@0.8.63 and rich-content@0.2.151 in this change. The guarded package-catchup-chat-20261012 run passed the latest-package guard, compile, lint, and the four originally failing unit suites (9 tests). Full extension CI and browser/Store acceptance remain pending.
cause: The published chat@0.8.62 package retained an import of @ai-matrx/data/net after the latest data package removed that export. The corrected shared source now imports @ai-matrx/api/net and is published as chat@0.8.63; the extension needed to refresh its package graph to consume it.
severity: S2: required unit CI and release validation are blocked; no product runtime impact has been established.
priority: P0: unblock current CI and release validation by publishing and adopting a compatible latest package graph.
evidence: Public @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.63 tarball: dist/host/diagnostics.js imports @ai-matrx/api/net; scan of 1,553 dist JavaScript files found zero @ai-matrx/data/net imports.

Guarded extension run package-catchup-chat-20261012: latest-package guard, compile, lint, and the four original failing unit suites (9 tests) passed with @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.63 and @ai-matrx/rich-content@0.2.151.
pnpm-lock.yaml contains the extension dependency refresh in this change.
next_action: Run full extension CI against the updated latest package graph and verify its result. Preserve the four-suite guarded pass as focused retest evidence; do not call it full CI. Browser/native and Chrome Web Store acceptance remain unverified and are not implied by package publication or CI. Reopen the defect if full CI reproduces the dependency failure.
